Name Plate Workshop

NP

Design a personalized name plate that reflects your style in this interactive DIY workshop in Malviya Nagar. Guided by experienced instructors, participants can experiment with different colors, textures, and decorative elements to create a unique name plate for their home or office. No prior artistic experience is required, making it suitable for beginners and hobby enthusiasts alike.
